featured_image.prompt: Ultra realistic magazine editorial photo, financial publication quality, shot with Canon EOS R5 85mm f/1.4 aesthetic. Subject: a newcomer to Canada proudly holding up a Canadian provincial driver's license card, standing just outside a driver examination/licensing office. Setting: modern Canadian city street, subtle skyline in soft background blur. Lighting: professional studio-quality soft diffused natural light, warm and welcoming, no harsh shadows. Color palette: deep navy #1B4F72, clean white, subtle gold accents #D4AF37. Avoid: cartoon style, AI artifacts, text overlays, clip art, generic office-desk stock-photo look, watermarks, any specific real government logo or brand signage. Quality: photorealistic, 4K equivalent, ultra sharp, professional composition.
featured_image.alt_text: Newcomer to Canada holding a Canadian provincial driver's license card outside a licensing office

comparison_graphic.prompt: Clean professional flat-design infographic, magazine publication quality. Side-by-side comparison chart titled implicitly by two columns: LEFT column headed by a foreign passport/ID card icon labeled 'Foreign Driver's Licence', RIGHT column headed by a Canadian driver's license card icon labeled 'Canadian Provincial Licence'. Each column lists 3 short rows with checkmark/cross icons (valid period, road test required, conversion process). Deep blue #1B4F72 and white background, green checkmarks, red crosses, clear typography hierarchy, no clutter, no generic government logos or trademarked branding, professional financial publication aesthetic.
comparison_graphic.alt_text: Comparison of a foreign driver's licence versus a Canadian provincial driver's licence for newcomers

checklist_graphic.prompt: Vertical portrait-format checklist infographic, clean flat professional design, magazine publication quality. Title area: 'Getting a Canadian Driver's Licence'. 5 numbered checklist rows, each with its own simple icon and short label: 1) passport/ID icon - 'Proof of identity', 2) small permit-card icon - 'International Driving Permit', 3) exam-paper-with-question-mark icon - 'Written knowledge test', 4) car-with-checkmark icon - 'Road test', 5) ID-card icon - 'Receive your licence'. Deep navy blue #1B4F72 and white palette, checkbox icons beside each row, clean modern typography, no cartoon style, no real government logos.
checklist_graphic.alt_text: Step-by-step checklist for a newcomer to get a Canadian driver's licence: ID, IDP, written test, road test, licence card

process_graphic.prompt: Horizontal flow-diagram infographic, clean flat professional design, magazine publication quality. 5 connected steps left to right with arrows between them, each with a small icon above its label: 'Foreign Licence' (passport icon) -> 'International Driving Permit' (permit-card icon) -> 'Written Test' (exam-paper icon) -> 'Road Test' (car icon) -> 'Canadian Licence' (ID-card icon). Deep navy blue #1B4F72 and white color scheme, numbered steps, clean modern icons, no cartoon style, no real government logos or brand signage.
process_graphic.alt_text: Process flow for a newcomer converting a foreign driver's licence to a Canadian one: IDP, written test, road test, licence
